LanguageData.LP_Aasimar.label: aasimar
LanguageData.LP_Aasimar.description: Mortals with celestial blood in their veins. Aasimar are handsome, with a faint halo floating overhead; they are naturally gifted at medicine and socializing, and holy light and necrotic power barely hurt them. Every aasimar has received a celestial revelation once: Radiant Soul (a leap), Radiant Consumption (a searing aura) or Necrotic Shroud (scatters the living). They loathe liches and necromantic constructs. The bloodline is inheritable.
LanguageData.LP_Aasimar.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Celestial resistance, healing hands, one of three celestial revelations, halo; good at medicine and social, loathe the undead.
LanguageData.LP_Tiefling.label: tiefling
LanguageData.LP_Tiefling.description: Mortals whose ancestors made a pact with a devil. Tieflings have horns and thin tails, with red or purple skin; they don't mind heat and fire barely burns them; when hit they strike back with hellfire, and when needed they can haggle with the devil once more. Others take a long time to accept them as one of their own. The bloodline is inheritable.
LanguageData.LP_Tiefling.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Infernal resistance, hellish rebuke, devil's bargain; horns, tail, red-purple skin, sociable but distrusted.
